title: 第15章 杀三人丰富战利品第16章 阴童教
slug: 开局黑狼拳简化后让我学狼叫
content_zh:
赵寒此刻正在一个平时休息的树洞内，盘膝而坐打开面板看着。
武者：赵寒
境界：炼皮
武功：黑狼拳，蛇形刁手
简化：黑狼拳【已简化，不入流，精通4001000，练习黑狼拳1000遍】
蛇形刁手【已简化，不入流，熟练10100，服用50枚蛇胆】
之前的那5枚蛇胆，都被赵寒给吞进了肚子里，变成了十点熟练度。
服用一枚蛇胆为两点熟练度。
50枚蛇胆，并不难，甚至比杀十头狼要简单安全。
只需要拿着足够的银子，去一趟县城就能办到。
“嗯，有声音！”赵寒忽然听到身后传来脚步声，立刻在树洞内藏了藏身体。
很快，三人到来。
“那小子跑的还挺快，继续追。”
“等我抓到他给他碎尸万段。”
“赶紧的，万一他回到矿场上，银子就打水漂了。”
三人一边跑一边骂，恨不得赵寒就在眼前。
三人的对话，全给赵寒听了进去。
双眼不由一冷。
我和他们仨无怨无仇，竟然为了点散碎银子就想要杀了我。
虽说财不外露，但为了一两银子就杀同帮之人，未免也太……

也许是见我单独一人势弱，或是见我大手大脚，这才敢来杀我的。
那我只好先下手为强了。
出了树洞，赵寒捡起一把泥土放在腰间的袋子里，悄咪咪的跟随他们仨。
三人也并未发现赵寒。
“该死的，这兔崽子跑的还挺快。”
“不得不服年轻人啊，腿脚就是比我们利索。”
“老了老了不中用了。”
三人似乎发觉赵寒离开了林子，便没有再追，而是原地休息。
却不知，他们的目标已经静待在后方，观察着他们仨的一举一动。
“走吧，继续捕蛇，数量少了可会被堂主骂的。”
三人休息一会，连忙起身，朝追来的路回去，那个方向的蛇比较多。
“嗖！”
就在三人走过一棵树干时，头顶忽然传来动静，一道人影从天而降，一拳打在领头之人的天灵盖上。
“啊……”
顿时，头顶被打的凹陷下去，领头之人直接双眼泛白倒了下去。
“是你！”
另外两人神色惊讶道。
content_en:
Zhao Han was currently in a tree hole where he usually rested, sitting cross-legged and opening the panel to watch.
Warrior: Zhao Han
Realm: Refining Skin
Martial Arts: Black Wolf Fist, Snake Shape
Simplified: Black Wolf Fist [Simplified, not popular, proficient 4001000, practice Black Wolf Fist 1000 times]
Snake-shaped Trickster [Simplified, not popular, proficiency 10100, take 50 snake gallbladders]
The five snake gallbladders from before were all swallowed by Zhao Han, turning them into ten points of proficiency.
Consuming one piece of snake gall is worth two points of proficiency.
It's not difficult to get 50 snake galls, it's even easier and safer than killing ten wolves.
All you need to do is take enough money and go to the county town to do it.
"Yes, there is a sound!" Zhao Han suddenly heard footsteps coming from behind him and immediately hid his body in the tree hole.
Soon, three people arrived.
"That kid is running pretty fast, keep chasing him."
"When I catch him, I'll cut him into pieces."
"Hurry, if he returns to the mine, all the money will be lost."
The three of them ran and cursed, wishing that Zhao Han was right in front of them.
Zhao Han listened to all the conversations between the three of them.
His eyes couldn't help but feel cold.
I have no grudges against the three of them, but they actually wanted to kill me just for some money.
Although the wealth is not exposed, it would be too much to kill fellow gang members just for a few taels of silver...
Maybe they dared to kill me because they saw that I was weak alone, or because they saw that I was lavish.
Then I had to strike first.
After leaving the tree hole, Zhao Han picked up a handful of soil and put it in the bag on his waist, following the three of them quietly.
The three of them did not find Zhao Han.
"Damn, this bastard is pretty fast."
"You have to obey the young people. Their legs and feet are much sharper than ours."
"I'm old and useless."
The three of them seemed to have noticed that Zhao Han had left the forest, so they did not pursue him again, but rested where he was.
Little did they know, their target was already waiting behind them, observing every move of the three of them.
"Let's go and continue catching snakes. If the number is too small, the hall master will scold you."
The three of them rested for a while, then quickly got up and headed back towards the path they had followed. There were more snakes in that direction.
"Whoosh!"
Just as the three of them were walking past a tree trunk, there was sudden movement above their heads. A figure fell from the sky and punched the leader on the Tianling Cap.
"Ah..."
Suddenly, the top of his head was dented, and the leader fell down with his eyes turned white.
"It's you!"
The other two people looked surprised.
